Definition: from G1456; to renew, i.e. inaugurate:--consecrate, dedicate.
BiblicalUsage: To dedicate, to inaugurate. The first testament was not dedicated without blood in Hebrews 9:18, and Christ has consecrated for us a new and living way through the veil, that is, His flesh, in Hebrews 10:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every dedication God accepts is sealed in blood, and the new way is open because Christ's flesh was torn like the veil — I walk through by His body, not my own.
